A type that links to an imported property group.

## Detailed Description
The imported [GroupQml](groupqml-qmlmodule.html).Trio type carries a named property group; every link below must land on the destination the producer publishes.
- Imported property group: [GroupQml.Trio.font](qml-groupqml-trio.html#font-prop)
- Imported group child: [GroupQml.Trio.font.family](qml-groupqml-trio.html#font.family-prop)
- Imported group child: [GroupQml.Trio.font.pixelSize](qml-groupqml-trio.html#font.pixelSize-prop)
